Fouzan relates in form to the Arabic root ف و ز (f-w-z) 'to succeed, be victorious' (cf. فوز fawz 'success', فائز fāʾiz 'winner'), and is current in South Asian Muslim naming with the sense 'success, triumph'. The source gloss 'protector' is a different root (ح ف ظ) and is not supported; the name is recorded at low confidence as a naming form of فوز. No meaning is asserted, because asserting one would require inventing evidence.
